## 5 Risk management framework and risk assessment

[Read section 5 in the full text](/edi-stelsel-certification/text/nl-p-01#s-5)

### REQ-5-01 {#req-5-01}

The Provider shall establish, implement, maintain and continually improve a documented risk-management framework covering the certified provider service.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-02 {#req-5-02}

The framework shall define risk ownership, risk acceptance authority, assessment criteria, treatment options, review frequency and escalation thresholds.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-03 {#req-5-03}

The Provider shall maintain a current risk assessment addressing threats, vulnerabilities, dependencies and impacts affecting confidentiality, integrity, availability, authenticity, privacy and sole user control.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-04 {#req-5-04}

The Provider shall map its assessment to the system risk register maintained under [NL-SYS-04](/edi-stelsel-certification/documents/nl-sys-04) and shall identify provider-specific additions, assumptions and residual risks.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-05 {#req-5-05}

Risk assessment shall cover interfaces and dependencies between the Wallet Provider, PID Provider, wallet solution, WSCA/WSCD, trust services, access-certificate services, registration-certificate services and other material ecosystem components.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-06 {#req-5-06}

The Provider shall reassess risk following significant change, incident, vulnerability disclosure, material supplier change, threat-intelligence update or change to applicable legal or scheme requirements.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-07 {#req-5-07}

Risk treatment decisions shall identify responsible owners, target dates, required evidence and residual-risk acceptance.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 10](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=10)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-08 {#req-5-08}

Risks that may affect certificate validity, subordinate assurance evidence, national admission conditions or another provider shall be reported in accordance with [NL-SYS-01](/edi-stelsel-certification/documents/nl-sys-01) and the applicable provider scheme.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 11](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=11)

- **Applies to:** Both
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-09 {#req-5-09}

The Wallet Provider shall specifically assess risks arising from wallet onboarding, activation, binding to the user, wallet-unit lifecycle operations and integration with the designated PID Provider.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 11](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=11)

- **Applies to:** Wallet Provider
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records



### REQ-5-10 {#req-5-10}

The PID Provider shall specifically assess risks arising from identity proofing, PID issuance, binding to a wallet unit, status services, revocation, fraud detection and dependencies shared by multiple Wallet Providers.

**Requirement** · obligation: **mandatory** · [PDF page 11](pathname:///files/edi-stelsel/2026-11-06/NL-P-01_Wallet_and_PID_Provider_Requirements_-_RC1.0_-_for_pub.pdf#page=11)

- **Applies to:** PID Provider
- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records

### REQ-7.5-01 {#req-7-5-01}

- **Typical evidence:** Document review, interview and operating records
